segments.title: WEEK 48 IN DRIFT
segments.text: This is Sideways Wire Weekly, week 48. Here is everything that happened in drift this week.

segments.title: CONOR SHANAHAN WINS IN JAPAN
segments.text: Guest entry, first time in the CUSCO GR Corolla, and a win: Conor Shanahan beat Naoki Nakamura in the wet final of D1GP Round 10 at Tokyo Drift, Odaiba. Brother Jack raced the sister car.

segments.title: FD 2027 SCHEDULE IS OUT
segments.text: Formula DRIFT is back at Englishtown and fans can see both PRO and PROSPEC finals in Las Vegas.

segments.title: IS JIMMY OAKES GOING PRO IN 2027?
segments.text: Jimmy Oakes has been building a pro-level 2JZ 240SX and said last year that going pro in Formula DRIFT is on his radar. Nothing is confirmed yet for 2027.

segments.title: MOST TALKED ABOUT
segments.text: The most talked-about drivers this week: Matt Field, Mika Keski-Korpi and Ryan Tuerck.

segments.title: SEE YOU NEXT WEEK
segments.text: That was the week. Follow Sideways Wire for every battle and every story, every week.
